HAZARDOUS WASTE
Improper and illegal disposal can contaminate our drinking water, impede
waste water treatment plants, pollute local waterways and endanger
wildlife. It can also lead to penalties and fi nes. The Household Hazardous
Waste Collection Facility is for the safe and legal disposal of unusable
hazardous products. Please remember to pack products carefully so
they won’t mix or spill. The facility accepts all types of hazardous waste
except:
NO RADIOACTIVES * NO EXPLOSIVES * NO AMMUNITION
HAZARDOUS WASTE INCLUDES:
O
METAL: Air compressors, barometers, CO2 cylinders and cartridges, fi re
extinguishers, helium, and propane
O
CONSTRUCTION: Asbestos, electrical switches & relays, fl uorescent ballasts,
freon, paint, paint thinners, painted wood, treated wood
O
MEDICAL: Inhalers, medicine, needles and sharps, oxygen tanks, thermometers
O
HOUSEHOLD: batteries, camping gas cylinders, cleaning products, drain opener,
fl ourescent lightbulbs, garden chemicals, kerosene, poisons, pool & hot tub
chemicals, shoe polish, solvents, and thermostats
O
MISC ITEMS: e-cigarettes, musical greeting cards, pepper spray and smoke detectors
